Nullsolve
Nullsolve (auto-updating)

Setup

  1. Show your bookmarks bar (Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + B) and drag a button onto it.
  2. Open any normal website and click the bookmark.
  3. Type a message. Your browser asks to share the screen once, then every message carries a fresh screenshot.

If you did not bake a key in, open the gear and paste one there. Keys entered in the panel are stored per site, so a baked-in key saves repeating that on every domain. Requests go straight from your browser to the provider you picked; this page talks to no server of its own.

Copy the raw bookmarklet

Auto-updating version

A ~1 KB bookmarklet that pulls the latest nullsolve.js from boosterfrank.github.io/nullsolve each time you click it, so updates arrive without re-installing. Sites that block external scripts need the full version above.
